CHAPTER.CAPTION: A Song of Ascents.
CHAPTER.VERS: In my distress I have cried out unto Jehovah, and He heard me.
Rescue my soul, O Jehovah, from lying lips and from a deceitful tongue.
What shall be given to you, or what shall be done to you, O deceitful tongue?
Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of the broom tree!
Woe is me, that I have sojourned in Meshech, that I have dwelt in the tents of Kedar!
My soul has dwelt long with him who hates peace.
I am for peace; but when I speak, they are for war.
